newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - VDH trading buy - Fraser.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - VDH trading buy - Fraser.

text.p: Engineering firm Van Der Horst Ltd is a "trading buy" despite its weaker than expected full year results, Fraser Securities Pte Ltd said on Monday.

"The company's earnings outlook remains firmly underpinned by a strong order book, amounting to about Singapore $511 million. These will provide the major impetus to the group's future earnings," Fraser said in a research note.

Fraser said Van Der Horst's US$142 million sub-contract by Enron Power Corp to build a 500-megawatt plant in East Java and another US$75 million 96 megawatt combined power plant in Semarang would spur profitability in 1997-1998.

Fraser added Van Der Horst's joint venture to develop and operate a 24.5 kilometre toll road in Indonesia plus its nine percent stake in a satellite project would provide recurrent earnings for the group.
On Friday, the group reported a 7.5 percent growth in profits to S$52.6 million for the year ended September 30, 1996.
